entries.title: Caching
entries.takes: that a cache hit skips the step entirely
quotes: a cache hit skips the step entirely and reuses its stored output

entries.title: Cache keys
entries.takes: that a key changes when any input file changes
quotes: the key changes whenever any file the step reads is changed

entries.title: Eviction
entries.takes: that the oldest entries are evicted first when the cache is full
quotes: When the cache is full, the oldest entries are evicted first
